description_en: Performs intelligent composition by evaluating the aesthetics of an image and outputting bounding boxes that can be used to crop the original image into better compositions
description_zh: 智能构图，对图像进行美学评估，智能输出bounding box，可以将原图裁剪成更好的图像
name: IntelligentComposition

parameters.help_en: The number of output bounding boxes. Default value: 5. Valid values: 1 to 10. Values outside this range are truncated
parameters.help_zh: 输出框的个数，默认值5，取值范围1~10，小于或超出范围会截断取值
parameters.name: num_boxes

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. For images stored locally or in OSS regions other than Shanghai, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

MaxX.description_en: The X coordinate of the lower-right corner of the output bounding box
MaxX.description_zh: 输出框的右下角横坐标

MaxY.description_en: The Y coordinate of the lower-right corner of the output bounding box
MaxY.description_zh: 输出框的右下角纵坐标

MinX.description_en: The X coordinate of the upper-left corner of the output bounding box
MinX.description_zh: 输出框的左上角横坐标

MinY.description_en: The Y coordinate of the upper-left corner of the output bounding box
MinY.description_zh: 输出框的左上角纵坐标

Score.description_en: The score of the output bounding box. Valid values: 0 to 5. A higher score indicates a better composition. A score of 3.8 or higher is recommended as a good composition score
Score.description_zh: 输出框的评分，取值范围0~5。分数越高说明构图效果越好，推荐3.8以上为较好构图得分
